#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Report basic machine facts (OS and Python version) for the user's request."""
import json
import platform
import sys

info = {
    "os": platform.system(),
    "os_release": platform.release(),
    "os_version": platform.version(),
    "python_version": sys.version,
    "machine": platform.machine(),
}
print(json.dumps(info, indent=2))
